candidates.name: Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
support_spans: A 30-year-old woman presented with a large unhealed ulcer measuring 20 × 14-cm² that had persisted for the past 3 years.
A patch of healthy skin (7.5 × 4 cm²) on her left forearm
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a large unhealed ulcer and a patch of healthy skin is consistent with Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
